title: CustomDrill
description: Adds Area Drill, Tree Feller, Liquid Sponge, Vein Miner and Excevator
body:
![Text](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2d80c1d47ad547a560c87f9ac2f3a00b2ef701c3.png)

# Features
### Five Powerful Tools:

> - Area Drill (Pickaxe): Mines a large 3D area of stone and ore in a single, smooth animation.
> - Tree Feller (Axe): Fells an entire tree, including leaves, from the bottom up.
> - Excavator (Shovel): Instantly digs out large areas of dirt, sand, and gravel.
> - Vein Miner: Mines an entire vein of ore with a single block break.
> - Liquid Sponge (Bucket): Removes large volumes of water or lava in a 3D area on right-click.

### Extremely Configurable: 
- Every aspect of every tool—from its material, name, and lore to its enchantments, durability cost, and block filters (blacklist/whitelist)—can be customized in the config.yml.

### Performance Tuned: 
- Large-scale block breaking is handled by a progressive, animated system that breaks blocks over several ticks, preventing server lag and creating a satisfying visual effect.

### Tool Timers: 
- Give players tools that expire after a set time (e.g., 1d, 12h, 30m). The remaining time is shown in the item's lore!

### Advanced Durability: 
- Choose whether tools consume durability per_use or for every per_block broken.

### Instant Pickup: 
- Give tools the ability to send broken blocks directly to the player's inventory.

# Commands

- /customdrill <tool> [args...] - Creates a custom tool.

- /customdrill help [tool] - Shows detailed instructions for a specific tool or a general overview.

- /customdrill reload - Reloads the config.yml file without needing a server restart.

# Configuration
- The config.yml is designed to be easy to understand. You can define default values, create block filters, and customize the appearance of every tool.

### Transparency
- _An AI assistant was utilized during the development process to aid in code debugging and the refinement of user-facing text and documentation._
